highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.2 corrects filtered image sampling and mask-filtered glyph rendering.
highlights_body: This servicing release brings native rendering fixes without changing the managed API surface.

bullets.lead: Keep filtered images within their source subset
bullets.detail: Ganesh sampling respects image subsets under minification, strong skew, AA clipping and MSAA, preventing unrelated backing-texture pixels from leaking into filtered images. Image-filter cache-key equality now matches hashing, including distinct floating-point representations.

Mask-filtered text uses the reloaded glyph's own outline, rejects incompatible mask formats before copying, and preserves full plane strides when clipping embossed glyphs. This avoids stale outlines, sub-byte buffer overwrites and corrupted or uncleared mask planes.

v4.156.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.2 corrects filtered image sampling and mask-filtered glyph rendering.
v4.156.2.body: It prevents unrelated backing-texture pixels from leaking into filtered images, aligns image-filter cache equality with hashing, and handles regenerated glyph masks and clipped embossed planes correctly. The managed API surface is unchanged.
